note: The display justifies (11.6.3) coker ũ_ℓ ≃ ker(ũ_ℓ⊗D_ℓ): with V = M_ℓ⊗Q_ℓ one has M_ℓ⊗D_ℓ = V/M_ℓ and M̌'_ℓ⊗D_ℓ = V/M̌'_ℓ, and the kernel of V/M_ℓ → V/M̌'_ℓ is M̌'_ℓ/M_ℓ = Φ(ℓ). As printed, the finite group Φ(ℓ) is equated with the divisible group V/M_ℓ, and Φ'(ℓ) plays no role here. Author's slip; the corrected left-hand sides are reconstructed from the argument. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
